skill_domain: skill creation workflows, domain expert simulation, self-bootstrapping

findings.title: Human-AI Collaboration in Knowledge Work: Workflow Patterns
findings.key_finding: Effective human-AI workflows require clear handoff points; AI should handle repetitive structured tasks while humans validate and steer; structured output enables human review
findings.design_impact: process.md 的「等待用户确认」节点（Step 1 后、Step 7 后）：结构化交接点设计

findings.title: Prompt Engineering for Structured Output Generation
findings.key_finding: Domain-specific prompts with examples outperform generic prompts; few-shot examples in YAML/JSON format significantly improve structured output quality
findings.design_impact: process.md Step 2 的 JSON schema 强制：结构化 sub-agent 产出防止质量退化

findings.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
findings.key_finding: LLMs can iteratively improve their outputs using self-generated feedback; each refinement cycle needs a clear stopping criterion to avoid infinite loops
findings.design_impact: self-bootstrap.md 的 Phase 1-7 闭环：每轮自举有明确的 fail→pass 证据要求和终止条件

top_insights: 用户最常见的失望点：创建的 skill 内容「通用」，无法体现领域专业性
自举闭环的最大风险：eval 由 skill-creator 自己设计，存在自我参照偏差，终极检验是唯一外部锚点
结构化确认点（Step 1 后的需求确认、Step 7 后的验收确认）是用户信任的关键

suggested_eval_cases.description: 创建的 skill 的 process.md 包含领域特异性步骤（非通用流程模板）
suggested_eval_cases.source_title: Human-AI Collaboration in Knowledge Work: Workflow Patterns
